Transparent Data Governance

Privacy Policy, Safety Contract & Disclosures

Understanding how SaarthiAI safeguards your laboratory data, enforces strict medical boundaries, and handles temporary file processing.

The Non-Negotiable Medical Safety Contract

AI Explains. Rules Compare. Doctors Diagnose. SaarthiAI is an educational assistant built to decode complex clinical terms. It is strictly prohibited from diagnosing diseases, claiming a condition is present, suggesting drug dosages, modifying prescriptions, or inferring that you do not need medical attention.

PROHIBITED BEHAVIOR:No automated diagnoses, medication adjustments, or fabricated reference ranges.
PERMITTED BEHAVIOR:Plain-language explanations, deterministic interval comparisons, and doctor consultation questions.

Temporary Retention

Uploaded reports are held in temporary memory for a maximum of 1 hour during your active session and are then permanently purged. No long-term storage exists without explicit patient booking consent.

Zero Public URLs

Your medical reports are never exposed via public static URLs. Any sharing with an associated doctor requires explicit consent and uses time-limited, access-controlled tokens.

Third-Party Processing

In offline sandbox mode, all extraction and explanations run entirely locally with zero external network calls. If live Gemini or external OCR is enabled, external transmission is clearly disclosed.

Strict Reference Range Policy

Reference intervals vary between laboratory methodologies, instrumentation, and patient populations. SaarthiAI never performs a free-form search or prompts an LLM to guess a reference range.

  1. Priority 1 (Report-Printed): We use the range printed on your specific laboratory report whenever it can be reliably parsed and matched.
  2. Priority 2 (Curated Indian Study Fallback): If the report does not supply a range, we consult our reviewed catalogue of peer-reviewed Indian population studies with full citation and provenance.
  3. Priority 3 (No Verified Range): If no verified, applicable range matches your analyte and unit, we mark it as NO_VERIFIED_RANGE and do NOT classify it as in-range or out-of-range.
Prototype Disclaimer

SaarthiAI is a hackathon-engineered patient education prototype. It has not received regulatory certification (such as FDA or CDSCO clearance) and does not claim HIPAA/GDPR clinical compliance without formal institutional auditing. Always consult a licensed medical practitioner for health advice.

Non-Negotiable Safety Contract:AI explains • Rules compare • Doctors diagnose.
SaarthiAI does NOT diagnose, prescribe, or replace clinical care.
